page.description: titles/page: the title of a page of an application, its h1 (text-title-page).

section.description: titles/section: the title of a section of a page (text-title-section).

dialog.description: titles/dialog: the title of a dialog (text-title-dialog).

part.description: titles/part: the title of a part, such as a card, a panel or an accordion item (text-title-part).

group.description: titles/group: the legend of a group of fields (text-title-group).
